name: rbmk_channel_cell
description: One 20px-pitch RBMK fuel channel: twin URAN rods in METL sleeves with GLOW indicator strips, an open 4px control-rod slot, and two 2px PIPE coolant risers. Tile N-wide at step [20,0].
why: Save 2001108 'The REAL RBMK1000' builds its 5-channel core from exactly this repeating cell (pitch 20px, x=282..369). GLOW columns beside each URAN rod are what the save's DTEC(ctype=GLOW) sensors watch for auto rod control; the 4px slot is where the FRME/VACU rod (see rbmk_rod_drive) descends. PIPE is laid 3-on/1-off vertically exactly as in the source (rows y%4==0 blank), which the source uses as flow-direction breaks. Bottom METL cap added so the slot is closed; source continues into a METL/PIPE header instead.
source: save 2001108, fuel section x280-299 y145-224 (80 rows); rod slot x284-287; repeats at x300,320,340,360
anchors_note: slot spans x=4..7 of the cell; place rbmk_rod_drive at [0,-45] relative to this cell so its PSTN/FRME rod is over the slot
